info.title: SEO Research API
info.description: Quickly see comprehensive keyword rankings for any URL or domain in every country. Instantly monitor your SEO progress, competitor shifts, and opportunities from the world's largest SERP index.

get.description:
Returns keywords that generate the highest organic click volume for a domain. This doesn't just work for full domains, it also works for paths, subdomains, individual pages, or specific URLs. This endpoint identifies the most traffic-driving keywords to reveal a domain's most valuable SEO assets and content opportunities.

[Visualize this API live on SpyFu](https://www.spyfu.com/seo/keywords/domain?includeAnyTerm=true&includeAnyUrl=true&searchType=mostvaluable&sidebarContext=filters&query=amazon.com)

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Full domain, specific URL, subdomain, path or page to analyze.

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.description: Column to sort results by.

x-enumDescriptions.SearchVolume: Number of searches done this past month on Google.com (or within selected country). Blended from multiple sources for better snapshot of search activity
x-enumDescriptions.KeywordDifficulty: SEO ranking difficulty score (0-100 scale, higher = more difficult to rank). Based on domain strength, on-page signals like 'keyword in title,' and number of .gov/.edu domains
x-enumDescriptions.Rank: Organic search result position (1 = top organic result)
x-enumDescriptions.RankChange: Change in organic position from previous data update (positive values indicate ranking improvement; negative values indicate moving further down the SERP).
x-enumDescriptions.SeoClicks: Estimated number of organic clicks the domain gets from ranking on this keyword
x-enumDescriptions.SeoClicksChange: Change in estimated organic clicks from previous data update
x-enumDescriptions.PercentMobileSearches: Percentage breakdown of searches from mobile vs desktop devices
x-enumDescriptions.PercentDesktopSearches: Percentage breakdown of searches from desktop vs mobile devices
x-enumDescriptions.PercentNotClicked: Rate that searchers leave the SERP without clicking any result
x-enumDescriptions.PercentPaidClicks: Percentage of SERP clicks that went to paid ads
x-enumDescriptions.PercentOrganicClicks: Percentage of SERP clicks that went to organic results
x-enumDescriptions.BroadCostPerClick: Average amount advertisers pay per click for broad match ads on this keyword
x-enumDescriptions.ExactCostPerClick: Average amount advertisers pay per click for exact match ads on this keyword
x-enumDescriptions.PhraseCostPerClick: Average amount advertisers pay per click for phrase match ads on this keyword
x-enumDescriptions.BroadMonthlyCost: Estimated monthly ad spend for broad match bidding
x-enumDescriptions.ExactMonthlyCost: Estimated monthly ad spend for exact match bidding
x-enumDescriptions.PhraseMonthlyCost: Estimated monthly ad spend for phrase match bidding
x-enumDescriptions.TotalMonthlyClicks: Total estimated clicks made on this SERP to any paid or organic results
x-enumDescriptions.PaidCompetitors: Total number of advertisers seen over the last 6 months for this keyword
x-enumDescriptions.RankingHomepages: Number of homepage URLs (vs deeper paths) ranking within first 100 results

parameters.name: sortOrder
parameters.description: Order to sort the results.

parameters.name: startingRow
parameters.description: Row number to start the results with.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: The maximum number of rows returned.

parameters.name: countryCode
parameters.description: Country market to search.  Specifically, this maps to the Google domain version to query against (e.g., google.com for US, google.de for Germany, etc.).

parameters.name: adultFilter
parameters.description: Exclude adult keywords considered unsafe for work.

parameters.name: onlyAdultKeywords
parameters.description: Only include adult keywords considered unsafe for work.

parameters.name: excludeHomepageKeywords
parameters.description: Exclude keywords that rank on the homepage of the searched domain.

parameters.name: keywordDifficulty.min
parameters.description: Filter by Keyword Difficulty

parameters.name: keywordDifficulty.max
parameters.description: Filter by Keyword Difficulty

parameters.name: adCount.min
parameters.description: Filter by the number of total advertisers.

parameters.name: adCount.max
parameters.description: Filter by the number of total advertisers.

parameters.name: searchVolume.min
parameters.description: Filter by the number of searches done this past month on Google.com

parameters.name: searchVolume.max
parameters.description: Filter by the number of searches done this past month on Google.com

parameters.name: includeTerms
parameters.description: CSV of terms that are required to be in the results.

parameters.name: includeAnyTerm
parameters.description: Require ANY or ALL terms from the includeTerms parameter to be in the keyword.  ANY = TRUE, ALL = FALSE.  ALL is the default.

parameters.name: excludeTerms
parameters.description: CSV of terms to exclude from any of the keywords.  This is always applied as an ANY.  No keywords with ANY of the terms in the CSV will be returned.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the most valuable keywords by organic click volume. Returns a paginated list of keywords prioritized by traffic value and search data.

schema.description: Response wrapper containing organic SERP keyword results with comprehensive SEO metrics and pagination metadata.

results.description: Array of organic search keywords with comprehensive SEO metrics including rankings, click estimates, and SERP analysis data.

keyword.description: The keyword for which this domain ranks organically in the top 100 search results.

topRankedUrl.description: The highest ranking URL from this domain for this specific keyword.

rank.description: Current organic search position for this keyword (1 = top position).

rankChange.description: Change in ranking position since the previous measurement period (positive values indicate ranking improvement; negative values indicate moving further down the SERP).

searchVolume.description: Monthly search volume for this keyword based on Google search data across the selected country/region.

keywordDifficulty.description: SEO difficulty score (1-100) indicating how challenging it would be to rank organically for this keyword, with 100 being most difficult.

broadCostPerClick.description: Average cost per click for broad match advertising on this keyword.

phraseCostPerClick.description: Average cost per click for phrase match advertising on this keyword.

exactCostPerClick.description: Average cost per click for exact match advertising on this keyword.

seoClicks.description: Estimated monthly organic clicks this domain receives from this keyword based on current ranking position.

seoClicksChange.description: Change in estimated organic clicks compared to the previous measurement period.

totalMonthlyClicks.description: Total number of clicks (organic and paid combined) on search results for this keyword in the past month.

percentMobileSearches.description: Percentage of searches for this keyword that come from mobile devices.

percentDesktopSearches.description: Percentage of searches for this keyword that come from desktop devices.

percentNotClicked.description: Percentage of searches where users leave the SERP without clicking any result.

percentPaidClicks.description: Percentage of total SERP clicks that go to paid ads.

percentOrganicClicks.description: Percentage of total SERP clicks that go to organic search results.

broadMonthlyCost.description: Estimated monthly advertising cost for broad match bidding on this keyword from the #2 position.

phraseMonthlyCost.description: Estimated monthly advertising cost for phrase match bidding on this keyword from the #2 position.

exactMonthlyCost.description: Estimated monthly advertising cost for exact match bidding on this keyword from the #2 position.

paidCompetitors.description: Total number of advertisers observed purchasing ads for this keyword over the last 14 months.

rankingHomepages.description: Number of domain homepages (vs. deeper pages) ranking in the top 100 organic results for this keyword.

items.description: Represents an organic search keyword with comprehensive SEO metrics including rankings, click estimates, costs, and SERP analysis data.

totalMatchingResults.description: Total number of organic keywords available that match the query criteria, including results not included in the current page.

400.description: Bad Request - Invalid parameters provided (e.g., invalid domain format, pageSize exceeds maximum, or invalid country code)

401.description: Unauthorized - Invalid API credentials or insufficient permissions to access SEO keyword data

500.description: Internal Server Error - A server-side error occurred while processing the request

Basic_Authentication_Token.description:
Basic Authentication is a standard that involves encoding your SPYFU_API_ID:SECRET_KEY into a Base64 string. Your SpyFu API ID and Secret Key can both be found under the Account Settings -> API Usage page. Additionally, you can find the Base64 string has been pre-generated on the same page under Base 64 Key. Finally, this encoded string is sent in the "Authorization" header prefixed with the keyword "Basic":
For example, to authorize as 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000:AB12WXYZ the client would send
Authorization: Basic MDAwMDAwMDAtMDAwMC0wMDAwLTAwMDAtMDAwMDAwMDAwMDAwOkFCMTJXWFla

Query_Parameter_Token.description:
An API key can be added as a query parameter. Your API key is listed as "Secret Key" found under the Account Settings -> API Usage page
For example, to authorize with the API key AB12WXY
/apis/example_api/GetExample?domain=spyfu.com&api_key=AB12WXYZ
Query_Parameter_Token.name: api_key

HMAC_Authentication_Header.description:
For even more security, each request can be individually authenticated with a timestamped HMAC (Hash Message Authentication Code) signature. Composed of your secret key, a valid timestamp, the API request path, and all request parameters.

Creating the signature:


Combine the pieces that will be converted into the signature.
StringToSign =
	HTTP-Verb + "
" +
	Timestamp + "
" +
	UrlPath + "
"
	QueryParameters;

Create UTF-8 encodings of the above string and of your secret key.
byte[] SecretKeyBytes = UTF-8-Encoding-Of( Upper-Case-Of( SECRET_KEY ) );
byte[] StringToSignBytes = UTF-8-Encoding-Of( StringToSign );

Use an implementation of HMAC256 using your UTF-8 secret key to encode the combined string of your request. This should then be converted to Base64 to finish creating your signature.
Signature = Base64( HMAC-SHA256( SecretKeyBytes, StringToSignBytes ) );

Using the signature:


This signature is then sent in through an Authentication header with your username.
Authentication: UserName:Signature
HMAC_Authentication_Header.name: Authentication
